description: The roll-up a fan-out surface prints above its tiles: how many units of work finished, are still running or failed, what the whole fan-out has cost so far and when it is expected to be over. A pure VALUE computed from a task list (Create), so the header, the detail surface and a test read the same numbers — a component never recomputes a summary inline. It is a snapshot: it carries no clock, and the live countdown is RemainingAt measured by the caller. The cost is the SUM of the tasks the host priced; a task without a price contributes nothing and HasCost stays false when NO task carries one, so a surface hides the money line instead of claiming the run was free.
usageExample:
var summary = FanOutSummary.Create(tasks);

summary.Finished;                       // 12
summary.RemainingAt(clock.GetUtcNow()); // the live time to the last active estimate
summary.TotalCostMicroUnits;            // the sum of the priced tasks, in micro-units

members.name: Create
members.description: Rolls a task list up. The order of the list is irrelevant to every number; a null list counts as empty, so a component never has to null-check the host's data.

members.name: RemainingAt
members.description: The time left until the last active task's estimate, measured on the caller's clock, or null when there is nothing to count (complete, or no estimate). An estimate in the past reads as zero, never as a negative duration.

members.name: Active
members.description: How many tasks still hold a worker (queued, running or waiting for a decision).

members.name: EstimatedEndAt
members.description: The LATEST estimate among the ACTIVE tasks, or null when no active task carries one. A finished task's estimate is ignored: the fan-out cannot end later because of work that is already over.

members.name: Failed
members.description: How many tasks failed (a failed task may still be retried).

members.name: Finished
members.description: How many tasks reached a terminal state (succeeded, failed or cancelled).

members.name: HasCost
members.description: Whether at least one task carried a price — false means "not priced", not "free".

members.name: HasEstimate
members.description: Whether the fan-out still has work AND at least one estimate to count down.

members.name: HasFailures
members.description: Whether the fan-out ended with at least one failed task that was never recovered.

members.name: Idle
members.description: How many tasks are neither running nor finished (an unknown state counts as waiting).

members.name: IsComplete
members.description: Whether there is nothing left to wait for: a non-empty fan-out with no active task.

members.name: Progress
members.description: The share of tasks that reached a terminal state, from 0 to 1; an empty fan-out reports 0 instead of a division by zero.

members.name: Queued
members.description: How many tasks are queued and not yet picked up by a worker.

members.name: Running
members.description: How many tasks are running right now.

members.name: Total
members.description: How many tasks the summary counted. Zero is a legal, empty fan-out.

members.name: TotalCostMicroUnits
members.description: The sum of the priced tasks, in MICRO-UNITS (1,000,000 is 1.00 of the currency).

members.name: WaitingForApproval
members.description: How many tasks are waiting for a human decision.
